reason: Verify user-value, maximum-performance requirements, exact seek behavior, memory ownership, and quantitative acceptance gates.
Verify slot safety proof, absolute-frame model, producer persistence, seek protection, source reuse, cache-line ownership, and rejected alternatives.
Verify phase ordering proves the primitive and benchmarks before integration and deletes the old transport before completion.
Confirm no callback allocation/lock/I/O/logging/destruction and that the final spec replaces the obsolete queue/ring contract.
Confirm typed current-generation errors and stale generation/epoch/serial suppression across source, producer, window, and callback boundaries.
Confirm callback/per-slot logging is absent and source errors sanitize credentials and signed URLs.
Confirm one PlaybackClock authority and one cache-line-aware streaming RT shape were implemented rather than parallel state splits.
Confirm the source seam supports persistent probe/cache/identity/recovery behavior required by remote playback.
Until the planned streaming modules exist, verify the current queue/ring and atomic ownership boundary is fully replaced rather than mirrored by new state.
Until the planned producer module exists, verify decoder reopen, per-block allocation/copy, fixed polling, and full-buffer duplication are actually removed during migration.
Verify distance-independent seek application, exact slot reads, release on every return, no RT destruction, and callback tail benchmarks.
Verify all decoded PCM owners use one exact capacity reservation ledger and no legacy path bypasses the process limit.
